_comment: Which memories go in the LOADED tier (MEMORY.md), selected by FUNCTION.
The one question to apply to every candidate: WOULD QUERY-TIME SEARCH FIND THIS WHEN IT
IS NEEDED? If the prompt that should trigger the rule contains the rule's own vocabulary,
search finds it and it does NOT belong here. If it does not - a scheduling preference, a
model choice, a name spelling, a person - search cannot help and the rule has to be
unconditional. Technical references in particular do not belong here: that is exactly
what the searcher is good at.
Copy this to loaded-tier.config.json (gitignored) and put your own slugs in. Each name
is a memory FILENAME without the .md, and a name with no file on disk is skipped with a
warning rather than failing the build.

ALWAYS.section: Tooling that silently changes what I see
